user_prompt:
method split_words(txt: string) returns (result: seq<string>)
    requires txt != null
    ensures (forall i: int :: 0 <= i < |result| ==> result[i] != null) // all words in the result are not null
    ensures (|result| > 0 ==> forall i: int :: 0 <= i < |result| ==> result[i] != "") // no empty strings in the result if it's not empty
    ensures (|result| == 0 ==> CountLowerCaseOdd(txt) == |result|) // if result is empty, it equals the count of lower-case letters with odd order
    ensures (|result| > 0 ==> (exists w: string :: w in result && IsWord(w))) // at least one word exists in the result

method CountLowerCaseOdd(txt: string) returns (count: int)
    requires txt != null
    ensures count >= 0 // count of lower-case letters with odd order is non-negative
    ensures count == CountLowerCaseLettersWithOddOrder(txt) // count is equal to the computed count of lower-case letters with odd order

function IsWord(word: string) : bool
    requires word != null
    ensures result == (forall c: char :: c in word ==> IsLetter(c)) // checks if all characters in the word are letters

function CountLowerCaseLettersWithOddOrder(txt: string) : int
    requires txt != null
    ensures result >= 0 // count is non-negative
    ensures result == CountOddLowerCaseLetters(txt) // returns the number of lower-case letters at odd positions
